prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1224; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid shows a crease along its lower edge, with the tail lamp assembly broken on the driver's side. Crush and paint transfer on the rear panels line up with the reported impact, and the damage pattern reads as one event. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours we have listed fit the scope of this work. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle, and the invoices we reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operations.
